assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production tree sprite for LETZTE SCHICHT, a gritty hand-painted pixel-art 2D industrial survival game. Create ONE complete tree only, on a genuinely TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. No backdrop, checkerboard, terrain, cast shadow, framing, labels, words or extra objects. Orthographic side elevation, square canvas, whole silhouette within a clear margin, the flat trunk foot at about 92% of image height. NO exposed hanging root tentacles: the thickened trunk foot meets a clean short horizontal ground cut; roots remain below the invisible ground and are not drawn. Crisp deliberate small pixel clusters, angular branches and intricate but readable bark, muted olive/sage/deep green foliage and charcoal umber bark, restrained upper-left light. Readable at 170-195 pixels tall. Preserve a detailed pixel-art game sprite appearance, not photorealistic, not blurry, no neon, no glossy 3D, no cartoon outlines. Crown has spatially distributed green foliage, open transparent negative spaces between boughs, and varied tiny leaf or needle clusters. Subject: one mature gnarled oak with a broad irregular low crown, stout subtly crooked trunk, visibly branching heavy boughs, distinct separated olive-green foliage masses and dark bark furrows. A readable rugged industrial woodland oak. Overall width roughly 90 percent of height, with a strong main trunk foot centered horizontally. A few subdued ochre leaf highlights, no flowers or fruit.
